blocks.text: ​MANDAUE CITY, Philippines — A fire struck a commercial warehouse in Upper Malibu, Barangay Subangdaku, Mandaue City, on Wednesday afternoon, October 7, 2026. ​Emergency teams responded after receiving the initial alert shortly past 4:00 p.m. Fire officials officially raised the incident to the first alarm status at 4:22 p.m. as smoke billowed from the facility.
